extracted_concepts.name: Arithmetic sequence
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sequence with constant difference d; a = a₁ + (n-1)d.

extracted_concepts.name: Arithmetic series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sum of first n terms of an arithmetic sequence.

extracted_concepts.name: Geometric sequence
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sequence with constant ratio r; aₙ = a₁ r^(n-1).

extracted_concepts.name: Geometric series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sum of first n terms of a geometric sequence.

extracted_concepts.name: Logarithm
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Inverse of exponentiation: log_a x = y iff a^y = x.

extracted_concepts.name: Complex number
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Number z = a + bi with i² = -1.

extracted_concepts.name: Polar form of complex number
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: z = r(cos θ + i sin θ).

extracted_concepts.name: Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Relation assigning each input one output.

extracted_concepts.name: Radian measure
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Angle measure with arc length s=rθ.

extracted_concepts.name: Arc length
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: s = rθ for angle θ in radians.

extracted_concepts.name: Sector area
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A = ½r²θ for angle θ in radians.

extracted_concepts.name: Trigonometric identity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Equation true for all valid angles.

extracted_concepts.name: Double angle formula
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: e.g. sin 2x = 2 sin x cos x.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Value a function approaches as input approaches a point.

extracted_concepts.name: Continuity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function has no breaks at a point/interval.

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Instantaneous rate of change; from first principles.

extracted_concepts.name: Binomial distribution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Distribution for number of successes in n trials.

extracted_concepts.name: Central Limit Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sampling distribution of mean tends to normal.
